ふらっと屋上に来てみると――: I wander up to the rooftop on a whim, and――
はぁー……風が気持ちいい……\nこれなら、ぐっすり寝れそう……:
Haah... the breeze feels so nice...
I feel like I could sleep soundly here...
んー？ 昨日は遅くまで牛丼屋のバイトが入っててさ……\n普段よりも睡眠時間足りな:
Hmm? I had a shift at the beef bowl place until late yesterday...
So I'm getting less sleep than usual.
さすがに授業中やばくて……\n教室で居眠りするくらいなら、ここで昼寝するかなって:
Class has been rough lately, honestly...
I figured if I'm going to doze off anyway, I'd rather nap here than in the classroom.
んじゃ、俺も一緒に寝るか！\n適度な昼寝は健康にもいいらしいからな。:
Then I'll nap with you!
They say a good nap is healthy for you, after all.
は？ なんでラミの隣に……: Huh? Why are you next to Rami...?
まあいいじゃないか。\n一緒に寝るのに、離れてるのも変だろ？:
Come on, it's fine.
It'd be weird to sleep together while keeping our distance, right?
てか、まず一緒に寝ていいとか別に言ってないし。\nせめて１００メートルは離れろ。:
And for starters, I never said you could sleep with me.
At least stay 100 meters away.
それだと俺ここから落ちて永眠するんだけど？: Wouldn't I fall off and sleep for eternity, then?
いいじゃん、熟睡できて――って、無理やり隣くんな！\n他の人の見られたら、誤解さ:
It's fine, you'd sleep soundly――hey, don't force your way next to me!
If someone else saw us, they'd get the wrong idea, wouldn't they!?
……って、えぇ……もう寝てる……早すぎでしょ。: ...Wait, huh... he's already asleep... That was way too fast.
……まあ、ちょっとくらいなら、いいか。\nこいつ枕にしてやろ。:
...Well, I suppose a little is fine.
I'll use him as a pillow.
そうして、俺たち二人で屋上でぐっすりと眠るのだった。: And so, the two of us slept soundly together on the rooftop.
疲れを取るには睡眠が一番だからな！\nよく眠れるように俺が協力するぞ。:
Nothing beats sleep for shaking off fatigue!
I'll help you get a good night's rest.
は……？ 協力って何？\n別に一人でも寝れるけど……:
Ha...? Help with what?
I can sleep fine on my own, though...
いや……そんな野太い子守唄とか、普通に睡眠妨害でしょ……\nつか、眠いから、もう:
No... a deep voice like that singing a lullaby would just keep me awake...
Besides, I'm sleepy, so can we stop...?
…………膝枕よろしく。コンクリート硬そうだし。: ............Lap pillow, please. The concrete looks hard.
